gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (p4) prints Debt Service Fund and Other Governmental Funds columns with no schedule of their own. Debt Service Fund: Property tax 7,525,252 + Payments in-lieu of taxes and franchise taxes 74,630 + Fees 388 + Intergovernmental 18,014 + Investment income 19,373 + Annexation revenues 178,072 + Miscellaneous 166 = 7,815,895; Other Governmental Funds: Intergovernmental 433,968 + Investment income 415 + Miscellaneous 228 = 434,611; added 8,250,506. The remaining 3,044,669 is a different basis: the General Fund (p5) and Community Betterment Fund (p6) schedules are budget basis while the statement is GAAP: General Fund GAAP 72,198,377 (p4) - budget actual 69,149,571 (p5) = 3,048,806; Community Betterment GAAP 1,113,977 - budget 1,117,985 (p6) = -4,008; LB840 Funds schedule (p10, a supplementary schedule that is not a statement column) 129 is in detail but has no separate statement column = -129. 3,048,806 - 4,008 - 129 = 3,044,669; 70,267,685 + 8,250,506 + 3,044,669 = 81,562,860 (p4). The Debt Service column's other financing rows (Refunding bonds issued 6,180,000, Premium on debt issued 326,649, Bond and loan issuance 3,910,000, Payment to refunded bond escrow agent (6,910,558), Transfers in (out), net (3,800,642)) are not in detail either; no gap row here covers them, so they are not added in this file.
